sources.quality_notes: First-party IIIF manifest 1245 canvases hash-bound, source-issued V09 p768 heading / p769 four photographed source-text loci / p770 next heading, 1600px source JPEG SHA256 9555f59d...; parent 13PS/13PT were catalog-only route until 13QI positive original image capture.
